purpose: Five screenshot-based design concepts for owner selection; not implemented in the model.

reference.type: Fresh live screenshot captured with CUA
reference.layout: Current bar-height island, three high stools, back-bar mirrored wine display, right-side door and console
reference.screenshot: Displayed inline in the conversation before generation

commonPrompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: photorealistic architectural interior design option for the Ashley Heights basement wine bar.
Input image 1 is the CURRENT REAL MODEL SCREENSHOT and is the layout/geometry reference. Transform that exact room into a believable professionally photographed high-end residential wine bar. Keep the same frontal eye-level camera, room width/depth, low flat ceiling height, rear wall, right-hand door position, right-side shallow console, centred rectangular BAR-HEIGHT island and exactly THREE HIGH upholstered stools along its front. Keep clear open access around both island ends and the aisle behind. Keep the back-wall wine storage and mirrored display in the same footprint. Do not turn this into a restaurant, enlarge the room, add windows, partition it off, create a U-shaped counter, or substitute a dining table. Retain two pendant locations over the island and wall-light positions; fitting designs can change. Show the full island, three high stools and side console in a single landscape photograph comparable to the reference.
Improve physically convincing surfaces and details: true wood grain at realistic scale, natural stone with subtle variation, stitched upholstery, solid joinery edges, bronze/brass wear, real stemware and wine bottles, accurate mirror reflections, lampshade translucency, grounded furniture shadows. Curated wine accessories, books, original abstract art, sculptural ceramics and a lamp make it feel furnished and lived-in without clutter. No people.
Lighting: richly layered but comfortably bright, clear ceiling and corners, warm 2700–3000K shelf/sconce/pendant light with soft neutral bounce, no crushed blacks, no orange cast, no patchy ceiling or glowing orange floor. Professional interior photography, plausible exposure and perspective, fine surface texture, no CGI plastic look. Change finishes, decorative detailing and furnishings' style according to the option while keeping the existing geometry and furniture positions. No UI, labels, logos, text, watermarks or collage. One large landscape image.

options.name: Warm oak & bronze
options.direction: An elevated evolution closest to the current setup: beautiful natural honey-oak fluted island and cabinetry, warm ivory honed limestone counter and large limestone floor slabs, cognac leather high stools with slender aged-bronze legs and footrests, brushed bronze shelf framing, clear antique-tinted mirrors, cream limewash walls. Elegant small bronze pendants, art with ochre/charcoal, a sculptural stone lamp. Welcoming, tactile, expensive understated contemporary wine bar.

options.name: Parisian Art Deco
options.direction: A refined Parisian Art Deco wine bar, sophisticated rather than theatrical: cream fluted island with restrained antique-brass vertical inlay and a warm lightly veined marble top, burgundy velvet/leather high stools with graceful curved brass frames, faceted or reeded-glass pendant fittings at the existing two positions. Right console with an elegant shaded lamp and sculptural ceramic. Geometric art and carefully curated bottles. Rich tactile luxury without gaudy gold or excessive ornament.

options.name: Soft European wine lounge
